scope: Independent scientific-claim and shortcut review; CPU only, not training or execution evaluation

context_boundary.collator_inspection: native_transform_input whitelists three RGB and state; high prefix uses only mode/goal/catalogue/visible_memory/visible_history/normalized state; audit metadata does not enter input

memory_conditions.EMPTY: 64 rows: active, confirmed=true, correct visible value
memory_conditions.KEEP: 32 rows: active, confirmed=false, correct visible value
memory_conditions.CORRECT: 32 rows: active, confirmed=false, wrong first-role side; goal already supplies answer
memory_conditions.CF_provenance: Authored bank confidence/corruption, not naturally occurring policy mistakes or executed recovery
memory_conditions.source_provenance: Full private bank audit contains source/layout; current strict actor view strips source; revision is visible

can_claim: Protocol-only SFT execution and parameter update if actual training receipts pass
Unrestricted EOS/JSON/READ-WRITE legality on teacher contexts
Lexical first-role left/right mapping on a fixed goal template
Paired same-input old action preservation on separately audited 8-case anchor if that test passes
cannot_claim: Visual grounding, temporal/MEM learning or multimodal condition use
Adaptive memory retrieval: every READ target is sample_identity
Natural uncertainty calibration or online memory error recovery
Autonomous READ->WRITE->SUBTASK closed loop: evaluation teacher-forces selected/corrected bank
Robot motor skill, verification/return-home success, task SR or Full50 retention
Independent 160-sample visual evidence: only 32 camera tuples and 8 layout families
followup_gates: Run generated READ then actual tool retrieval, generated WRITE then actual apply and generated SUBTASK with no teacher bank replacement
Measure text-only/image-shuffle/image-occlusion controls when claiming visual improvement
Add genuinely observed relevant change, occlusion or failure with causal labels; keep privileged simulator truths audit-only
Increase independent families and episode-level uncertainty estimates before claiming generalization
